root_cause.text: The kalmia driver binds to any USB interface with vendor-specific class without checking for the required bulk IN and OUT endpoints, allowing a malicious device to trigger null pointer or invalid pipe access when the driver later uses those unverified endpoint descriptors.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a call to `usb_check_bulk_endpoints(intf, ep_addr)` with the expected endpoint addresses (0x81 IN, 0x02 OUT) and returns -ENODEV if validation fails. This directly addresses the missing endpoint verification that could lead to crashes, as described in the CVE: "the driver will crash later on when it blindly accesses these endpoints."
